articles.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
articles.snippet: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

articles.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs: WSJ
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s board could meet as soon as today to decide Jensen Huang’s future, WSJ reports.

articles.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
articles.snippet: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

articles.title: Kraken Parent Payward Brings 200 UK and EU Stocks Onchain as xStocks
articles.snippet: The expansion takes xStocks past 1,500 tokenized assets, though the new UK tokens still can't be bought by investors in the UK.

articles.title: Nvidia Sheds $430B in Two Days as Jensen Huang Faces Calls to Resign
articles.snippet: Nvidia's independent directors have hired Wachtell Lipton to investigate its CEO's ties to an alleged Chinese spy, as pressure mounts.
